output_list.criticism: The function getTokens accepts any amount of ETH, then calculates the number of tokens that would be distributed to the sender based on the current rate. The current rate is based on the number of tokens per ETH. However, the function does not check if the msg.value is enough to cover the minimum transaction value which would result in no tokens distributed. As a result, any sender can purchase a negligible amount of tokens if they send a small amount of ETH. This could lead to unfair distribution of tokens to the contributors.
